0cESbNbpYyJtuodHwEBVqA.zh: 德國今年6月迄今報告39例病例,且上一個流行季(2025年6月迄今年3月)累計報告116例病例,其中至少24例住院,全基因組定序顯示,本次流行菌株與歐洲(17個國家)於2011-24年期間疫情(逾600 例)流行之菌株,以及奧地利於2025年檢出之菌株相,疑感染源為義大利進口之番茄,懷疑為灌溉用水受汙染所致。當局警告疫情屬跨年性⻑期流行,且受污染番茄已流入多個歐洲國家。
0cESbNbpYyJtuodHwEBVqA.en: Germany has reported 39 cases since June this year. The previous epidemic season (June 2025 to March this year) reported 116 cases in total, at least 24 of whom were hospitalised. Whole-genome sequencing shows that the outbreak strain is closely related to strains that circulated in Europe (17 countries) during 2011–24 (over 600 cases), as well as to a strain detected in Austria in 2025. The suspected source is tomatoes imported from Italy, with contaminated irrigation water suspected as the cause. Authorities warn that this is a multi-year outbreak and that contaminated tomatoes have reached several European countries.

iymtXWKxKDK0GdRYj6rd3Q.zh: 奧地利今年8/27報告東北部林茲(Linz)7/20-8/27期間,累積報告31例確定病例、3例死亡,其中有4例住院,針對檢出陽性之冷卻水塔,已進行清潔及消毒,感染源仍待釐清調查中。
iymtXWKxKDK0GdRYj6rd3Q.en: On 27 August this year, Austria reported that in Linz in the north-east, 31 confirmed cases and 3 deaths had been cumulatively reported for 20 July–27 August, of whom 4 were hospitalised. Cooling towers that tested positive have been cleaned and disinfected; the source of infection remains under investigation.

KVndG6H0ESMvTZdnm_c-4A.zh: 英國、奧地利、比利時等共10個歐州國家今年截至5月累計報告109例病例,其中1例死亡、18例住院,病患以女性、成人為多,經調查感染源為苜蓿芽種子,由印度進口並分銷歐洲各地,各國已要求廠商將產品下架,ECDC評估此事件對於經常食用者的風險為低至中。
KVndG6H0ESMvTZdnm_c-4A.en: Ten European countries, including the United Kingdom, Austria and Belgium, reported 109 cases cumulatively this year through May, including 1 death and 18 hospitalizations. Patients are mainly female and adults. The source of infection was identified as alfalfa sprout seeds imported from India and distributed across Europe. Countries have required manufacturers to withdraw the products from sale. The ECDC assesses the risk of this event to frequent consumers as low to moderate.

1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:今年累計報告H5N1流感5例、H9N2流感12例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,303起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共15國於2026/3/11-4/30期間報告439起H5N1疫情,德國361起、智利18起、南韓14起、波蘭13起、泊爾7起、法國5起、美國/臺灣各4起、加拿大3起、丹麥/奧地利/挪威/荷蘭各2起、柬埔寨/義大利各1起。 南韓於2026/4/29報告4起H5N9疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,093起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/19-25共425個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/馬里蘭/麻薩諸塞州共11個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.en: Update. Human cases: this year, 5 H5N1, 12 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human influenza cases have been reported cumulatively. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,303 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Fifteen countries reported 439 H5N1 outbreaks between 11 March and 30 April 2026: Germany 361, Chile 18, South Korea 14, Poland 13, Nepal 7, France 5, the United States and Taiwan four each, Canada 3, Denmark, Austria, Norway and the Netherlands two each, and Cambodia and Italy one each. South Korea reported four H5N9 outbreaks on 29 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 425 sampling sites during 19–25 April 2026, of which 11 sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Maryland and Massachusetts detected H5-positive results.

GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年2/28累計144國/地區報告18萬1千餘例確診病例,其中,至少492例死亡。 今年2月共計46國家/地區報告1,184 例新增確診病例,其中4例死亡,58.6%來自非洲地區,相較今年1月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降或持平,阿根廷、奧地利及中非共和國通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/2/1-3/15)共計17國通報907例確診病例,其中7例死亡,以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、肯亞、蒲隆地及賴比瑞亞為高;非洲以外地區,奧地利、比利時、葡萄牙、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。
GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.en: Monthly update: Since 2022 and up to 28 February this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 181,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 492 died. In February this year, 46 countries and regions reported 1,184 new confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; 58.6% came from the African Region. Compared with January this year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined or held steady. Argentina, Austria and the Central African Republic reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (1 February–15 March 2026), 17 countries reported 907 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths; the highest numbers were in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi and Liberia. Outside Africa, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to report clade Ib community transmission.

_HWF3JvIGh-A4t3nkTJC3A.zh: 中歐多國爆發疫情,其中奧地利、捷克、匈牙利、斯洛維亞今年截至10月累計報告逾6,000例病例,其中41-80%住院,病患多為街友或毒品使用者等脆弱族群,病毒型別涵蓋兩組相近的IB型,此波疫情遠高於去年,並已擴及9個歐洲國家,另迄未發現食源性傳播跡象。
_HWF3JvIGh-A4t3nkTJC3A.en: Several Central European countries have experienced outbreaks. Austria, Czechia, Hungary and Slovenia reported more than 6,000 cases cumulatively as of October this year, of which 41–80% were hospitalised. Most patients belong to vulnerable groups, such as homeless people or people who use drugs. The virus types include two closely related genotype IB clusters. This outbreak is far higher than last year's and has spread to 9 European countries. No evidence of foodborne transmission has been found so far.

kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.zh: 中歐國家疫情升高,今年截至6月累計報告逾2,000例,9例死亡,其中斯洛伐克880例、捷克600例、匈牙利530例、奧地利87例,德國3起個案與匈牙利病例基因序列一致,顯示疾病跨域傳播,惟未發現疫情蔓延。ECDC表示此波疫情流行主要為IB型之2個基因群組,影響包括遊民、吸毒者及居住不良衛生環境族群,評估大於40歲為高風險族群,呼籲加強疫苗接種及衛生措施。 中國今年截至6月累計報告逾1.1萬例病例,高於去年同期(7,500例)。
kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.en: Hepatitis A is rising in Central European countries. As of June this year, more than 2,000 cases and 9 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Slovakia 880, Czech Republic 600, Hungary 530 and Austria 87. Three cases in Germany have genetic sequences identical to Hungarian cases, indicating cross-border transmission, although no wider spread has been detected. The ECDC says this wave is mainly caused by two genogroups of genotype IB, affecting homeless people, people who use drugs, and people living in poor sanitary conditions. People over 40 are assessed as high-risk, and the ECDC calls for stronger vaccination and hygiene measures. China has reported more than 11,000 cases as of June this year, higher than the 7,500 cases in the same period last year.

ZUgDGJvpaQo0YAtbVh87Zg.zh: 德國於6/16報告85例病例,病患多為0-4歲,發病日介於4-5月,奧地利亦有零星個案,至少30例個案住院治療,4例個案出現敗血症;當局調查覆盆莓口味腰果醬為疑感染源,產品已下架。
ZUgDGJvpaQo0YAtbVh87Zg.en: Germany reported 85 cases as of 16 June. Most patients are aged 0–4, with onset between April and May. Austria has also had sporadic cases. At least 30 cases were hospitalized, and 4 cases developed sepsis. Authorities investigated raspberry-flavoured cashew butter as the suspected source, and the product has been withdrawn from sale.

JnaKcCoFR_36KooLFEVHOw.zh: 歐洲報告自今年1月截至2/6,檢測出有相同基因關聯的菌株(Shigella sonnei ST152)聚集,顯示有相同的感染來源,分別為英國報告20例、奧地利/法國均為7例、荷蘭1例,其中27例有國際旅遊史,主要於亞洲國家旅行。病患介於15-70歲,多數為女性。發病期間為1/8-17,感染源仍不明,ECDC評估可能有國際間旅行傳播的可能性。
JnaKcCoFR_36KooLFEVHOw.en: From January to 6 February, Europe detected a cluster of strains with the same genetic link (Shigella sonnei ST152), indicating a common source of infection: the UK reported 20 cases, Austria and France 7 each, and the Netherlands 1. Among them, 27 cases had an international travel history, mainly to Asian countries. Patients were aged 15–70, and most were women. Illness onset was between 8 and 17 January. The source of infection remains unknown, and the ECDC assesses that transmission linked to international travel is possible.
